entry.title: New: Resolution 704 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE EXTENSION OF THE PUBLIC SEWER FROM AN EXISTING SEWER LINE TERMINUS AT PUKIHAE BRIDGE TO HAU LANE, WITHIN HAWAI‘I BELT ROAD, TO SERVICE TAX MAP KEYS: 2-6-015:001 AND 002 AT AHUPUA‘A OF WAINAKU, DISTRICT OF SOUTH HILO, ISLAND AND COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I, STATE OF HAWAI‘I

The extension would service the Hawaiian Ola Brewing Corporation for its operations at 238 Belt Road in Hilo.
